title: Reading Drill — Planning benches at a railway museum — Reviewing the evidence
description: One short passage, six questions. Recommended time: 10 minutes.

passages.title: Planning benches at a railway museum — Reviewing the evidence
passages.body:
**A** The gallery planner in Hillswick received an old report about visitors unable to rest near the longest information displays. The report compared seats occupied at busy times, but some entries had been collected under different conditions. To check the report, reviewers returned to the short observation sessions rather than treating the published figures as a complete record.

**B** The review covered seven weeks. In the first part of that period, the original records did not consistently include temporary school tours. In the later part, the recording sheet included a separate field for it. The reviewers kept readings from both periods, but marked which items were missing rather than guessing what had happened.

**C** The conclusion listed a bench near the longest display as a possible later response. It recommended collecting another set of readings before deciding whether to use it. The new data would be published with the method, so another group could work out whether its own measurements were comparable.
